messages:
Sam: FYI postmortem for recent KV-cache thrash posted: https://redwood.notions/pm/kv-cache-thrash
IncidentBot: New postmortem created by Sam — link above. Summary: cache eviction pattern + fallback didn't trigger
Neha: assigning remediation items in tracker now. Major ask: make triage checklist explicit for cache thrash
Oliver: +1. I propose we add a quick commands section and an escalation path to Eng Oncall
Sam: drafted commands — paste snippet
```
# check hot-keys
kubectl -n inference exec -it svc/cache-inspect -- /bin/bash -c 'redis-cli INFO memory | grep used_memory'
# force fallback
curl -X POST https://infra.redwood/api/v1/control/fallback -d '{"policy":"model-variant-fallback"}'
```
Ashley: Can we make the fallback command idempotent? last time it caused a ripple
Oliver: I'll test and wrap it in a small script with locking
Matt: ownership: Neha for runbook edits, Oliver for commands script, Ashley for safety test, Sam for rollout plan
Neha: putting due dates: runbook edits EOD Thu (2024-05-02), commands script Wed (2024-04-30), safety test Fri (2024-05-03)
Sam: noted. I've created the action items in the postmortem tracker: https://go/repo/actions/12345
Neha: Also adding an escalation matrix: if latency > 200ms for 3 consecutive mins -> page eng-oncall -> if no ack 5m -> page eng-sre-senior
Oliver: propose adding a short blurb in triage: check model-variant-fallback status, check KV cache hitrate: `curl https://metrics/api/hitrate?service=cache`
Ashley: will validate the metrics query and add the grafana panel
Sam: I'll ship a brief runbook PR and tag folks for review. @Neha -> please confirm owners after your edits :thumbsup:
Neha: confirmed, will post final PR link when ready
Matt: can we add a recurring quarterly audit for these playbooks? pattern seems recurring
Neha: added on our backlog with tag 'recurring-incidents'
Sam: thanks all. follow-up check-in next Tue 10am to verify rollout
IncidentBot: Reminder scheduled: Check-in meeting created for 2024-05-07 10:00 (calendar invite sent)
